exposure: Delivery mode (VBAC vs. vaginal delivery in primiparous women)
cohort: 141 women who had a term VBAC and 113 primiparous women who delivered vaginally
finding: VBAC is associated with a significantly higher rate of LAM avulsion compared to vaginal delivery in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) was associated with a significantly higher rate of levator ani muscle (LAM) avulsion compared to vaginal birth in women who had not previously given birth vaginally.
